products.name: Meesho App
products.description: Zero-commission horizontal marketplace; discovery-led commerce; AOV ~₹260; 70%+ orders from discovery/recommendations

products.name: Meesho Mall
products.description: Dedicated platform for branded products; 1,200+ brands; NMV grew 93% YoY in Q1 FY27; transacting consumers +88% YoY

products.name: Valmo
products.description: In-house logistics arm launched Feb 2024; aggregates small logistics service providers; handled ~50% of orders (flat for 3 quarters as of Q1 FY27); 2% in FY23 → 60% by mid-2025

products.name: Meesho Ads
products.description: Advertising revenue from sellers and brands; primary revenue driver alongside logistics

products.name: Content Commerce
products.description: Short videos, live streams, influencer campaigns; 50,000+ active content creators

products.name: Kirana Club
products.description: Acquired July 2026 for ₹202 crore all-cash; B2B marketplace for kirana stores

products.name: AI tools
products.description: Vision Language Models for counterfeit detection; GenAI voice agents with local language support; AI Blitz for engineering productivity

legal.description: CCPA fined Meesho ₹10 lakh for selling unapproved walkie-talkies without ETA certifications; violations of misleading advertising, unfair trade practices, deficiency in services under Consumer Protection Act 2019; 1,896 non-toy walkie-talkie products listed by 85 sellers between Jan 2023 and May 2025; 2,209 walkie-talkies purchased from single seller without compliance docs
CCPA ordered probe after Meesho delisted unregistered herbicide product; part of wider crackdown on e-commerce platforms selling non-compliant products

CCPA issued Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Illegal Listing and Sale of Radio Equipment on E-Commerce Platforms, 2025; 16,970 non-compliant walkie-talkie listings identified across platforms; Meesho fined ₹10 lakh along with Amazon, Flipkart, Meta
Filed plea with NCLT Bengaluru for reverse merger of India unit Fashnear Technologies with US parent Meesho Inc to pave way for IPO
